oracle: independent Decimal fixed-K FIEGARCH(1,d,1) Gaussian QML

provenance.reference_note: finite fractional truncation and fixed sample initialization are explicit oracle choices

contract.normalization: divide residuals by maximum absolute demeaned residual
contract.fractional_filter: f[t]=sum(k=0..min(t,K-1), pi[k]*g[t-k]); K is runtime fixture data
contract.domain: alpha,gamma unrestricted; beta in (-1,1); d in [0,0.5); exact d=0 face plus interior

cases.name: interior_long_memory
cases.purpose: Interior finite-K FIEGARCH fit with material fractional memory.

cases.name: interior_long_memory_reflected
cases.purpose: Exact sign reflection: gamma changes sign and variance quantities agree.

cases.name: d_zero_boundary
cases.purpose: Exact d=0 face, including its one-sided KKT derivative and EGARCH identity.

cases.name: negative_beta
cases.purpose: Negative-AR fit demonstrating the full beta domain; this fixture selects the exact d=0 face.

cases.name: near_d_half
cases.purpose: Finite valid recurrence near, but separated from, the open d=0.5 boundary.

cases.name: quiet_extreme_probe
cases.purpose: Valid Decimal recurrence remains ordered while binary64 QML reaches +infinity.

cases.name: constant_failure
cases.purpose: Demeaning produces zero scale, so volatility parameters are unidentified.
cases.failure: demeaned maximum absolute residual is zero
